meta.commitMessage:
fix(autonomy): preserve evidence origin and valid follow-up plans

Integrate reviewed Vision catalogue changes. Correct model fact provenance and planner examples, preserve a freshly verified scheduled check in estimate fallbacks, and add scoped diagnostics for declaration types and context failures. Fix live runner follow-up admission and numeric interval verification without relaxing outcome gates.

Preserve original 630 CI/live reports and failed attempts. Local code snapshot 9fdc2af passed 1653 tests with one optional provider test skipped; scripted scenarios passed 9/9 with no real model calls or external effects. New remote CI and live acceptance remain pending.
